text: Two Phone rings Phone rings Hello? Hello Mum, it's me, Alan. Oh hello, I was worried. Did you arrive safely? Yeah, sorry, we got here late. That's why I didn't phone. Oh right. So is everything OK? Are you both well? Yeah, fine. Except for the cockroaches in the hotel. Cockroaches? Yeah, we stayed in this little place last night and the room was filthy. That's horrible. Ah, we were silly. We should have looked around more, but because we got here so late, we just chose the first cheap place we came across. Oh Alan. Don't worry, we'll check the place out better next time. I hope so.
